subject: June ops readout: service economics & reliability
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: June ops readout: service economics & reliability

Team — attaching the June service dashboard and the raw latency breakdown. High level summary up top: 

- Latency: P50 unchanged (42ms) but P95 increased from 210ms -> 318ms for hosted small models; root cause looks like bursty long-tail due to an increased share of long-context sessions.
- Cost: unit cost/1000 tokens up ~9% month-over-month driven by (a) higher GPU spot pricing in us-west, (b) fallback to higher-capacity model variants during peak.
- Uptime: 99.985% in the month; two short infra blips on 6/03 and 6/11 (both auto-recovered).
- Usage: overall tokens up 18% driven by a single customer (Acme AI) onboarding heavy batch scoring.

Asks: 
1) Please review page 3 of the dashboard (attached) and call out top three discrepancies you want escalated to Eng/Infra.
2) Confirm whether the current fallback-runbook (attached) is sufficient for auto-failover to dedicated pools, or if we need an additional canary step for latency-sensitive routes.

I plan to summarize for the exec QBR on Monday. If you have spot issues you want me to surface, reply by EOD Monday PST.

Attachments: 2027-06-service-dashboard.pdf (report, 9 pages), latency-breakdown-202706.csv (CSV), fallback-runbook-2027-06.md (markdown)

—Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Service Reliability & Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: June ops readout: service economics & reliability

Markus — quick pass on the dashboard: good work. A few quick notes before I synthesize for the execs: 

- Page 3 (latency cohorts): call out the context-length distribution shift and link to the Acme AI onboarding cohort — they're responsible for ~42% of the P95 delta. Recommend a one-line note: "investigate request truncation & prefix caching for Acme large-batch flows".
- Cost: agree that GPU spot volatility is a big factor. Ops should provide 7-day trailing spot delta in next dashboard (new column request).
- Uptime: the 6/03 blip appears to be an autoscaler race condition; I've asked Infra to provide a post-mortem draft by Tue.

Action items for exec slide: 
- Call out two mitigations: (1) apply prefix-KV caching to Acme batch jobs, (2) temporarily pin Acme routes to dedicated pool during onboarding window (tradeoff: extra committed cost).

I'm okay with the fallback-runbook as-is but please insert a canary check for the latency-sensitive route (route=/v1/stream/*).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ops@acme.ai <ops@acme.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: June ops readout: service economics & reliability

Hi Markus / Laura — thanks for the readout and the detailed dashboard. A couple of clarifications from our side as we ramp: 

1) The spike in long-context sessions is coming from a templating job we kicked off on 6/01; we expect that to finish by 6/22 and then average context length should fall ~15-20%. I'll confirm.
2) On cost: can you confirm the delta that is attributable to routing fallbacks vs spot pricing? We need to quantify the bump for our procurement review (GreenCloud will ask).

If pinning our routes to dedicated for a week is the recommended mitigation, we are okay with that but need an SOW addition and cost estimate. Can you please send a short note with the expected cost delta for a 7-day pin (per-100k tokens) and the change in expected P95?

Thanks — happy to sync on a 30-min call if needed.

—Ravi (Ops)
Acme AI

Ravi / team — thanks for the quick reply and the heads-up about the templating job. Next steps: 

- Cost delta: we'll produce a short cost estimate by EOD Mon (expectation: ~+$120 per 100k tokens for dedicated pin during onboarding window; final number after infra confirms allocation).
- Mitigations to implement this week: (1) enable prefix-KV caching for Acme batch flows (Grace to own), (2) apply a 7-day dedicated pin for Acme routes once Procurement signs the SOW (Laura / Stephanie to coordinate with GreenCloud procurement).
- Runbook change: added canary check for /v1/stream/*; see fallback-runbook-2027-06.md (attached).

Action owners: 
- Grace: implement caching and post the rollout checklist in JIRA-OPS-1248 by Mon EOD.
- Laura: draft SOW note and cost delta for procurement; loop in GreenCloud.
- Stephanie: prep a 2-slide summary for Monday exec QBR (latency impact, cost tradeoffs, proposed ask).

I'll include these three action items in the QBR slide and mark as "high priority".

—Markus
Markus Klein
